label: A5 history interpretation scope controls
paraphrase: Analyst formal controls: integer onset satisfies population/member first occurrence and predecessor transition; rational onset has no immediate predecessor; a first natural-number moment permits onset without predecessor; member onset need not be population onset; recurrence separates predecessor transition from first occurrence; roster controls check exact exclusion, empty negative content, classification scope and full-history versus past cutoff. These are full-carrier test interpretations, not metaphysical possibility or source attribution.
